title: The Missing Star of Snowfield
titleTh: ดาวที่หายไปของเมืองสโนว์ฟิลด์
note: เนื้อเรื่องแต่งใหม่สำหรับ EnglishQuest (ร่างโดย AI) — ต้องให้ผู้ดูแลตรวจและอนุมัติทุกตอนในหน้าผู้ดูแลก่อนเปิดให้ผู้เล่นเห็น · ไม่ระบุระดับ CEFR (ยังไม่ได้ประเมินโดยผู้เชี่ยวชาญ)

chapters.title: A Quiet Morning
chapters.titleTh: เช้าวันที่เงียบผิดปกติ
chapters.text: It is the first day of December in the small town of Snowfield. Mali wakes up early and looks out of her window. Snow covers the roofs, and the big tree in the town square is ready for the festival. But something is wrong. The golden star at the top of the tree is gone! People stand around the tree and talk quietly. "Without the star, we cannot light the tree," says Mr. Holt, the baker. Then Mali sees small footprints in the snow. They go from the tree toward the old library. A little fox with a red scarf is sitting next to them.

questions.q: What is missing from the tree?
questions.why: "The golden star at the top of the tree is gone!"
"They go from the tree toward the old library."

chapters.title: The Fox Called Pip
chapters.titleTh: จิ้งจอกชื่อพิป
chapters.text: The fox looks at Mali and says, "Hello. My name is Pip. I can help you, but you must help me too." Mali is surprised, but she smiles. "How can I help you?" she asks. Pip explains that the star did not fall. A strong wind carried it away last night. "The wind left three clues," Pip says. "Each clue is written in English. If we read them carefully, we can find the star before Christmas Eve." Pip gives Mali a small card. On the card, there are only four words: "Look where stories sleep."

questions.q: What does Pip say happened to the star?
options: A strong wind carried it away
questions.why: "A strong wind carried it away last night."

questions.q: How many clues did the wind leave?
What is written on the card?
questions.why: On the card: "Look where stories sleep."

chapters.title: Where Stories Sleep
chapters.titleTh: ที่ที่เรื่องเล่าหลับใหล
chapters.text: "Stories sleep in books," Mali says. "The clue means the library!" They walk to the old library. It is warm inside, and it smells of paper and hot chocolate. The librarian, Ms. Reed, is putting books on a high shelf. Mali asks her politely, "Excuse me, did you see anything strange last night?" Ms. Reed thinks for a moment. "Yes. The window was open this morning, and I found this on the floor." She shows them a piece of silver ribbon. On the ribbon, someone wrote the second clue: "Go where bread is warm before the sun is up."

questions.q: Why does Mali think the clue means the library?
questions.why: "Stories sleep in books... The clue means the library!"

questions.q: What did Ms. Reed find on the floor?
questions.why: "She shows them a piece of silver ribbon."

questions.q: The second clue most likely points to...
questions.why: Bread is warm before sunrise at a bakery — and Mr. Holt is the baker.

chapters.title: Before the Sun Is Up
chapters.titleTh: ก่อนพระอาทิตย์ขึ้น
chapters.text: The next morning, Mali and Pip go to the bakery at five o'clock. Mr. Holt is already baking. The kitchen is full of the smell of cinnamon. "You are early!" he laughs. Mali tells him about the clue. Mr. Holt looks surprised. "Last night I heard a noise on the roof, but I was too busy to check." They climb the ladder carefully. On the roof, under a thin layer of snow, there is a small wooden box. Inside the box is the last clue: "The star is where the town can see everything."

questions.q: What time do Mali and Pip go to the bakery?
questions.why: "...go to the bakery at five o'clock."

questions.q: Why didn't Mr. Holt check the noise?
questions.why: "...but I was too busy to check."

questions.q: Where do they find the last clue?
options: In a box on the roof
questions.why: "On the roof... there is a small wooden box. Inside the box is the last clue."

chapters.title: The Light of Snowfield
chapters.titleTh: แสงแห่งสโนว์ฟิลด์
chapters.text: "Where can the town see everything?" Mali asks. Pip points to the old clock tower on the hill. From the top, you can see every house in Snowfield. They climb the long stairs together. At the top, next to the big clock, the golden star is shining in the snow. Mali carries it back to the square, and everyone cheers. On Christmas Eve, the tree lights up, and the whole town sings. Mali turns to thank Pip, but the little fox is gone. Only a red scarf is left on the bench, with a note: "Thank you for reading carefully. Merry Christmas!"

options: At the top of the clock tower
questions.why: "At the top, next to the big clock, the golden star is shining."

options: The tree lights up and the town sings
questions.why: "On Christmas Eve, the tree lights up, and the whole town sings."

questions.q: What does Pip leave on the bench?
options: A red scarf and a note
questions.why: "Only a red scarf is left on the bench, with a note."
